biotools.summary: Castanet is a pipeline designed for rapid analysis of targeted multi-pathogen genomic data, providing end-to-end processing and consensus sequence generation with features like a graphical interface and installer script. It’s designed for flexibility, working with existing methodologies and supporting multi-pathogen enrichment experiments.
biotools.name: Castanet
